m1-double-center-falsifier.title: Double-centering transform + interaction-replication r + 3-arm falsifier + NEGATIVE-CONTROL
m1-double-center-falsifier.imperative: Create src/physics/instrument_panel/replication.py with: grand_two_way_center(grid) implementing the DOUBLE-CENTERING interaction residual residual[d,c]=v[d,c]-driver_mean[d]-class_mean[c]+grand_mean (pure arithmetic data transform, NOT a fitted interaction term); per_driver_demean(grid) removing ONLY the driver main effect (the WRONG correction, provided for the negative control); and interaction_replication_r(grid_a, grid_b, *, center=grand_two_way_center) computing the split-half Pearson r of the double-centered per-driver interaction-residual profile over the shared (driver,class) cells between the two halves. Create tests/unit/physics/instrument_panel/test_replication_channel.py with a synthetic generator EXTENDING #665's additive model with a TRUE driver x class interaction term, and the THREE-ARM falsifier: (a) pure overall-skill -> r~=0 (does not replicate); (b) pure shared-class ZERO interaction -> after double-centering r~=0 (does not replicate); (c) injected interaction -> r HIGH (>= threshold) and monotone in strength. Plus the NEGATIVE-CONTROL test: per_driver_demean-ONLY reports HIGH r on arm (b) (proving double-centering is necessary, not cosmetic). RED: write the tests first (module absent), run pytest, observe failure -- manual attest c1. GREEN: implement until the pytest command passes.

m2-channel-comparison.title: Injected thresholds + r_floor + per-class channel comparison (winner/tie/unresolved/unmeasurable)
m2-channel-comparison.imperative: Extend replication.py with a frozen ReplicationThresholds(threshold, min_support_n, r_floor_cap, r_floor_support_ref, channel_tie_margin) dataclass and a pure r_floor(n, thresholds) implementing threshold+(r_floor_cap-threshold)*clip((r_floor_support_ref-n)/r_floor_support_ref,0,1). Add a CellValue(driver,class_id,value,support) observation type and compare_channels_by_class(channel_halves, thresholds) that, per class per channel, filters cells below min_support_n, double-centers each half, computes the per-class across-driver split-half r, then applies the registered decision rule: the higher-r channel earns the join weight iff its r>=r_floor(n) AND it beats the other by channel_tie_margin; neither clears -> unresolved (no-frame-kill); both/one clear within tie margin -> default utilization; insufficient support (<min_support_n per half or <2 resolved units per half) -> explicit unmeasurable verdict (a COMPLETE result). Thresholds are INJECTED params (test injects proposal defaults threshold=0.5,min_support_n=15.0,r_floor_cap=0.7,r_floor_support_ref=100.0,channel_tie_margin=0.1); DO NOT import a frozen module. Add tests covering r_floor math, and the winner/tie-default/unresolved/unmeasurable decision paths. RED then GREEN.
